title: ChatGPT: Jack of all trades, master of none
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured stance detection (favor, against, none) on the topic of atheism, as part of the TweetStance task.
findings: The paper evaluated ChatGPT's performance on the TweetStance task, which includes detecting stance towards atheism. The model achieved an F1 Macro score of 56.44%, which was a 16.29% performance loss compared to the state-of-the-art (SOTA) model's score of 67.42%. The paper did not provide a breakdown of findings specific to the atheism topic versus the other topics within the task.
